afterward|adv|之後；後來|We attended the meeting and had lunch afterward.|我們參加會議後一起吃了午餐。|Please read the report and call me afterward.|請先閱讀報告，之後打電話給我。
attendee|noun|出席者；與會者|Each attendee received a conference badge.|每位與會者都領到一張會議識別證。|The organizer sent directions to all attendees.|主辦單位把交通指引寄給所有出席者。
businessperson|noun|商人；商界人士|A successful businessperson listens to customers.|成功的商人會傾聽顧客的意見。|The workshop is open to every local businessperson.|這場工作坊開放給每位當地商界人士參加。
by-law|noun|地方自治法規；組織章程|The new by-law limits overnight parking.|新的地方規定限制夜間停車。|Members voted to change a by-law of the association.|會員投票修改協會的一項章程。
caterer|noun|宴會餐飲承辦商|The caterer will deliver lunch at noon.|餐飲承辦商會在中午送達午餐。|We asked the caterer to provide vegetarian meals.|我們請餐飲承辦商提供素食餐點。
copier|noun|影印機|The copier is out of paper.|影印機沒有紙了。|Please use the copier near the reception desk.|請使用接待櫃檯附近的影印機。
cordless|adj|無線的；不需電線連接的|The office purchased a cordless phone.|辦公室買了一支無線電話。|This cordless drill comes with two batteries.|這支無線電鑽附有兩顆電池。
devastate|verb|嚴重破壞；使極度難過|The storm devastated several coastal towns.|暴風雨重創了幾個沿海城鎮。|The sudden factory closure devastated the community.|工廠突然關閉，對當地社區造成沉重打擊。
dissatisfy|verb|使不滿意|Poor service can dissatisfy customers.|不良的服務會使顧客不滿意。|The limited choices may dissatisfy some guests.|選擇有限可能讓部分客人不滿意。
distractor|noun|干擾選項；分散注意力的事物|One distractor looks correct but does not fit the sentence.|其中一個干擾選項看似正確，卻不符合句意。|The teacher explained why each distractor was wrong.|老師解釋了每個干擾選項錯在哪裡。
donut|noun|甜甜圈|She bought a donut on her way to work.|她上班途中買了一個甜甜圈。|The bakery sells fresh donuts every morning.|這家麵包店每天早上販售新鮮甜甜圈。
downsize|verb|縮減規模；裁員|The company plans to downsize its regional office.|公司打算縮減區域辦公室的規模。|Several departments were downsized after the merger.|合併後，有幾個部門縮減了人力。
economize|verb|節省；節約開支|We need to economize on office supplies.|我們需要節省辦公用品的開支。|The hotel is trying to economize without reducing service quality.|飯店正設法節省開支，同時維持服務品質。
entrée|noun|主菜（美式用法）|Each entrée comes with a side salad.|每份主菜都附一份配菜沙拉。|Please choose an entrée from the dinner menu.|請從晚餐菜單中選一道主菜。
flextime|noun|彈性工時制度|Our company offers flextime to full-time employees.|我們公司提供全職員工彈性工時制度。|Flextime allows her to start work earlier.|彈性工時讓她可以提早開始工作。
fundraise|verb|募款|The volunteers fundraise for a local hospital.|志工為當地一間醫院募款。|We plan to fundraise through a charity concert.|我們打算透過慈善音樂會募款。
healthcare|noun|醫療保健|The company provides healthcare benefits to its staff.|公司提供員工醫療保健福利。|Demand for healthcare services continues to grow.|醫療保健服務的需求持續增加。
housekeep|verb|料理家務；負責家務工作|She housekeeps for an elderly couple.|她為一對年長夫婦料理家務。|They hired someone to housekeep while they were away.|他們雇人在外出期間料理家務。

misplace|verb|把物品放錯地方；一時找不到|I misplaced the receipt for my train ticket.|我把火車票的收據放錯地方，一時找不到。|Please contact reception if you misplace your room key.|如果你找不到房間鑰匙，請聯絡櫃檯。
newsstand|noun|報攤；報刊販售處|You can buy a newspaper at the station newsstand.|你可以在車站的報攤買報紙。|The newsstand also sells maps and snacks.|這個報攤也販售地圖和零食。
obligate|verb|使負有義務；使有責任|The contract obligates us to finish by Friday.|合約規定我們有義務在星期五前完成。|Signing the form does not obligate you to buy anything.|簽署表格不代表你有義務購買任何東西。
overcharge|verb|多收費；收費過高|The restaurant accidentally overcharged us.|餐廳不小心向我們多收了錢。|Please let us know if you think you were overcharged.|如果你認為被多收費，請告訴我們。
overcrowd|verb|使過度擁擠|Too many visitors can overcrowd the small gallery.|過多遊客會讓這間小藝廊過度擁擠。|The waiting room was overcrowded during the morning rush.|早晨尖峰時段，候診室擠滿了人。
overpay|verb|付錢過多；多付|We overpaid the supplier by fifty dollars.|我們多付了供應商五十元。|Check the invoice carefully so that you do not overpay.|仔細核對發票，以免多付錢。

photocopier|noun|影印機|The photocopier needs a new toner cartridge.|這台影印機需要更換碳粉匣。|A technician will repair the photocopier this afternoon.|技術人員今天下午會來修理影印機。
photocopy|verb|影印|Please photocopy these documents before the meeting.|請在會議前影印這些文件。|She photocopied the signed contract for her records.|她影印了簽署後的合約以供留存。
proofread|verb|校對|Please proofread the brochure before printing it.|請在印製前校對這份手冊。|He proofread the report to check for spelling mistakes.|他校對了報告，檢査是否有拼字錯誤。
purser|noun|船舶或客機上負責旅客服務與事務的主管|The purser helped the passenger locate a missing bag.|事務長協助旅客尋找遺失的行李。|Please ask the purser about the ship's schedule.|關於船舶的行程，請詢問事務長。

repairperson|noun|維修人員|The repairperson will arrive before noon.|維修人員會在中午前抵達。|We called a repairperson to fix the broken refrigerator.|我們請維修人員來修理壞掉的冰箱。
